## ADDITIONAL SKILLS

- Typing Speed : 55WPM
- Canva
- Problem Solving
- Analytical Thinking
- Quick Learner / Adaptable

## SUMMARY

BCA student currently learning backend development with Node.js and Express.js, aiming to build a strong foundation in server-side technologies. Interested in starting a career as a backend developer and gaining practical experience through real-world projects and professional work.

## PROJECTS

## Post Management Platform -

Built a backend-driven post management platform using Node.js, Express.js, and EJS. Implemented JWT-based authentication along with features such as  user  registration,  login,  post  creation,  edit  and  like  functionality  by registered users.

## Premium Bag Shop Web Application -

Developed an e-commerce style web application using Node.js, Express.js, EJS,  and  MongoDB.  Implemented  product  listing,  server-side  rendering, routing, and database integration for managing bag products.

## Contact Management System -

Developed a backend contact management system using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB. Implemented user authentication and CRUD operations for managing contacts with structured REST API routes.

## Banking System REST API -

Developed  a backend banking system using Node.js, Express.js,  and MongoDB with secure authentication using JWT. Implemented RESTful API endpoints for account management and transaction operations.

## Patient Appointment Backend System -

Developed a backend REST API using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB for patient  registration  and  appointment  booking,  with  email  confirmation notifications using Nodemailer.

## EDUCATION

## Bachelor of Computer Applications

Learning web development, database management, and programming fundamentals to build practical IT solutions.
